 AHL Game Preview: Abbotsford Canucks at Coachella Valley Firebirds with Projected Lines 11/15/2026
 JC Giff 
 Nov 15, 2026 
 Abbotsford Canucks (9-4-0-2, 20 points) at Coachella Valley Firebirds (6-5-3-1, 16 points) 
 Venue: Acrisure Arena
 Date: Sunday, November 15, 2026
 Time: 3:00 PM PST
 How to Watch: AHLTV on FloHockey
 Purchase tickets via Ticketmaster 
 Abbotsford Canucks News & Notes
 The Abbotsford Canucks enter Sunday following a 5-2 loss to the Ontario Reign on Saturday night. Chase Wouters scored on the power play in the first period, while Kole Lind added another power-play goal late in the third. Abbotsford surrendered three first-period goals and couldn’t recover as Ontario received two goals from Francesco Pinelli.
Abbotsford enters with a 9-4-0-2 record and 20 points, averaging 3.40 goals scored and 2.93 allowed per game. The Canucks are 2-0-0-0 against Coachella Valley this season, winning 7-3 on October 17 and 5-4 in a shootout on October 18.
 Coachella Valley Firebirds News & Notes
 The Coachella Valley Firebirds return to action following a 2-1 victory over the San Jose Barracuda on Thursday night. Ryden Evers opened the scoring before Ian McKinnon scored the 1,000th regular-season goal in Firebirds franchise history. Victor Östman made 35 saves as Coachella Valley successfully killed all seven San Jose power plays.
The Firebirds enter Sunday with a 6-5-3-1 record and 16 points, averaging 2.93 goals scored and 3.40 allowed per game. Coachella Valley is 0-1-0-1 against Abbotsford, losing 7-3 on October 17 before falling 5-4 in a shootout on October 18.

 Players to Watch
 Abbotsford Canucks 
Ty Mueller, Trey Fix-Wolansky and Riley Patterson are among the team’s scoring leaders with 12 points. Mueller is leading in goals with seven. Kirill Kudryavtsev recorded an assist Saturday, moving him to eight. Gavin White leads the Canucks with a plus-eight rating.
 Coachella Valley Firebirds 
Tyson Jugnauth leads the Firebirds with 15 points and 15 assists through 15 games. Jani Nyman remains the overall goals leader with nine but is inactive, leaving Eduard Šalé as the active leader with five. Julius Miettinen leads the active roster in plus/minus at plus-three.
 Next Game
 Abbotsford: November 18 at Ontario Reign
Coachella Valley: November 17 at Calgary Wranglers
 Boston Bruins Young Guns w/ Andrew Fantucchio 
 – 
 Inside The Rink 
 The Bruins might be better than you thought, but the real question is how long this keeps up. Boston just banked 7 of 8 points on a California-and-Dallas road swing, and Andrew Fantucchio breaks down why the wins are promising, the slow starts are still worrying, and one frustrating decision in Dallas may say a lot about Marco Sturm’s trust in his young players. Andrew Fantucchio, credentialed reporter for the Boston Bruins at Inside the Rink, joins Connor to react to the latest breaking news around Marat Khusnutdinov's new three-year extension and explain why Boston clearly sees him as more than a bottom-six placeholder. They dig into his value as a versatile, two-way forward, his fit in Sturm’s system, and why his deal says so much about where the Bruins think this roster is headed. You’ll also hear a sharp read on the biggest storylines from the trip:
 why Boston’s repeated slow starts are a real concern, even in victory
 how the young core like Poitras, Hagens, Brunet, and Lohrei is driving five-on-five production
 why the Bruins’ veteran-heavy late-game approach against Dallas backfired
 what Nikita Zadorov’s benching, penalties, and agent-driven noise really mean
 whether Fraser Minten is actually a second-line center, or just getting overhyped by the usual Toronto discourse
Then the conversation widens to the rest of the league, with a look at Brady Tkachuk’s return to Ottawa, the scary situation surrounding Penguins prospect Ben Kindel, and the absurd pace Connor McDavid is setting as he continues to look like a cheat code for the Edmonton Oilers.This one is perfect if you want a real Bruins pulse check, a smart take on the team’s young talent, and a bigger-picture view of the NHL’s most interesting early-season storylines.
